response.original_title: Black At: A Black Students Matter Movement
response.overview: BLACK@ is an activist coming-of-age documentary following Black students navigating racism, belonging, and identity at predominantly white Pre-K–12 private schools. Through intimate interviews, animation, and archival footage, the film explores the experiences that inspired the Black At movement and the journey toward reclaiming identity, community, and purpose.
response.title: Black At: A Black Students Matter Movement
